title: {name} wants to talk contract
text: He's out of contract at season's end and wants security now. On today's form he's worth {ask} a season.

choices.label: Wait for the off-season
choices.note: No commitment yet. He'll ask for what he's worth then: less if his form drops, more if he improves.

effects.why: You made him wait on a new deal

choices.result: {name} is disappointed, but it can wait for the off-season.

stakes: Extend now: {more_seasons} at {early_price} a season, locked in. Wait, and his price moves with his form.

title: Rival clubs are circling {name}
text: His manager says two clubs have called. He wants to know he's wanted here.

choices.label: Tell him he's in your plans

effects.why: You told him he was in your plans

choices.result: {name} hears what he wanted to hear.

effects.why: You let the market decide his future

title: {name}'s manager is talking him up
text: He's on radio saying his client is "weighing up his options".

choices.label: Ring the manager

effects.why: You went over his head to his manager

choices.result: You have a word with the manager. It goes quiet.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: You leave it. The board doesn't like reading it.

title: {name} wants to know about next year
text: He wants an answer before the season's out: is there one more year for him?

effects.why: You were straight with him about his future

choices.label: Tell him it'll be sorted after the season

effects.why: You put off talking about his future

title: {name} wants to know where he stands
text: He's on a rookie deal and hasn't had a senior game. His family are asking questions.

choices.label: Tell him he's part of the plans

effects.why: You told him he was part of the plans

choices.label: Tell him he has to earn it

effects.why: You told him he had to earn his place

title: {name}'s manager has called
text: Other clubs are asking about him, and he hasn't forgotten you made him wait.

choices.label: Tell him a deal is coming at season's end

effects.why: You told him a deal was coming
You let him test the market

title: {name}: the paper has him headed interstate
text: A paper has {first} on another club's shopping list, and his manager has rung. He's out of contract at season's end and wants it sorted before Round 1.

choices.label: Tell him it waits until the season's under way
choices.note: No commitment yet. He'll ask for what he's worth then: less if his form drops, more if he improves.

effects.why: You put off his contract talk with another club interested

choices.result: {first} isn't happy to be put off, with the paper still running the story.
